items.title: Sandisk stock begins trading at 8-for-1 split, shares sink
items.summary: Sandisk shares began trading at an 8-for-1 split on Friday.

items.title: AI trade stocks hit hardest after Jensen Huang’s exit from Nvidia
items.summary: Investing.com -- The market is treating the AI trade as a complex ecosystem, not a single stock, and the damage is widest among companies that depended on NVIDIA (NVDA)’s spending and financing. The 1-month moves are from the Nov 19 snapshot.

items.title: Sandisk Stock Looked Like It Fell 87%. Here’s What Really Happened.
items.summary: The rationale for the move was that the company’s stock has increased significantly since its spin-off from Western Digital in February 2025

items.title: Micron Sinks 6%, Sandisk Down 7% as Chip Selloff Deepens Memory’s “Abject Disaster”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron Technology fell 6% today as the chip selloff hit memory stocks, Sandisk and SK hynix included. Analysts expect Micron’s EPS to more than double in fiscal 2027, and over 75% of its 2027 output is committed.

items.title: SanDisk Tumbles 8% as TrendForce Turns Bearish on 2027 NAND Prices; Micron Falls 5%, SK Hynix Slides 4%
items.summary: SanDisk has already lost nearly half its value in a month, and a new price forecast just hit the one product it sells. Can its locked-in data center contracts protect the stock when NAND turns, or do the bears have this right?

items.title: Anthropic, Nvidia, AMD, Intuit, Bloom Energy, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slide adds pressure to artificial-intelligence stocks as chip makers and data center suppliers retreat.

items.title: Here’s Why SanDisk Has The Cleaner Setup Over Bigger Rival SKHynix to Through The End of 2026
items.summary: One memory giant is nearly eight times bigger and has contracts stretching to 2030. The other just posted 378% revenue growth, then lost almost half its value in a month. Which one holds the stronger hand before the year ends?

items.title: Micron’s President Says Memory Has Been Tight “Across Really Multiple Years.” TrendForce Sees DRAM Prices Rising Through 2027
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron’s president said memory has been tight “across really multiple years,” and TrendForce sees DRAM prices holding up through 2027. Micron’s first new Boise fab isn’t expected to produce wafers until mid-2027.
